body: Commission on the Status of Women
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN

  Municipal Services Building, 633 E. Broadway, Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the meeting of the Glendale Commission on the Status of Women. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s
Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp. PLEASE TURN OFF
MOBILE PHONES AND PAGERS WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to items on this agenda that are received
less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Management Services Department, 613 E.
Broadway, Suite 200, Glendale, CA 91206. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
Management Services Department at (818) 548-4844 during regular business hours.

  February 10, 2020, 5:30 pm

  1. ROLL CALL
  A. Report regarding the posting of the Agenda: The Agenda for the February 10, 2020
  meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside of City Hall on or before
  February 7, 2020.

  2. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  A. Presentation: Teen Dating Violence – Laura Ourfalian, ACSW, Ofelia Oundjian,
  AMFT

  3. ORAL COMMENT: Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of this agenda. Each
  speaker is allowed 5 minutes. The Commission may question or respond to the
  speaker but there will be no debate or discussion. Staff may refer the matter to the
  proper department for investigation and report.

  4. CONSENT ITEMS
  A. Approval of the minutes of the Special Commission Meeting held on
  November 12, 2019

  5. BUSINESS AGENDA
  A. Action Items
  1. Consideration and Discussion of a Partnership with Soroptimist International of
  Glendale for a Human Trafficking Educational Event
  a) Motion Providing Direction Regarding a Request for a Monetary
  Contribution and In-Kind Services
  2. Update on the Commission on the Status of Women’s Legislative Agenda
  a) Motion Providing Direction on One Additional Bill
  3. Update Regarding Ad Hoc Committees to Support the 2019-22 Strategic Plan
  for the Commission on the Status of Women
  a) Motion Providing Further Direction on Ad Hoc Committees
 B. Reports – Information Only
  1. Update Regarding Program Celebrating the Centennial of the 19th Amendment to
  the United States Constitution

6. COMMISSIONER/STAFF COMMENTS

7. ADJOURNMENT

  Next Regular Meeting will be held on Monday, May 11, 2020, at 5:30 pm
Municipal Services Building, 633 E. Broadway, Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206 (unless
  otherwise noted)
